title: Everything Wants You Dead
description: Everything Wants You Dead is a Minecraft mod that turns the entire world into a nightmare—every living entity, from passive animals to villagers and monsters, becomes hostile and relentlessly hunts the player. There are no safe
body:
Welcome to a world where… **everything wants you dead.**

Cows are no longer food.
Chickens don’t lay eggs.
Villagers don’t trade… they throw hands.

Everything you once trusted
is now chasing you.

No safe houses.
No allies.
No mercy.

Just footsteps… getting closer.

![Just footsteps… getting closer.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67f1a2d6c9b32e85016152112ce546cbc387c93c.png)

**Will you run?**
**Will you fight?**
**Or will you accept your fate?**

If you like this mod, consider following my channel for more updates!
